_description: Offline heuristic reference DB with official citations for UXP reasoning

1.name: Nielsen #1 — Visibility of System Status
1.desc_vi: Hệ thống phải luôn giữ người dùng được thông báo về trạng thái hiện tại thông qua phản hồi phù hợp trong thời gian hợp lý.
1.desc_en: The design should always keep users informed about what is going on, through appropriate feedback within a reasonable time.

sources.name: Nielsen Norman Group
sources.quote: The system should always keep users informed about what is going on, through appropriate feedback within a reasonable time.

sources.name: Laws of UX
sources.quote: The design should always keep users informed about what is going on.

2.name: Nielsen #2 — Match Between System and the Real World
2.desc_vi: Hệ thống phải sử dụng ngôn ngữ của người dùng, với từ ngữ, cụm từ và khái niệm quen thuộc, thay vì thuật ngữ nội bộ.
2.desc_en: The design should speak the users' language, with words, phrases, and concepts familiar to the user, rather than internal jargon.

sources.name: Nielsen Norman Group
sources.quote: The design should speak the users' language.

3.name: Nielsen #3 — User Control and Freedom
3.desc_vi: Người dùng thường chọn chức năng hệ thống do nhầm và cần một lối thoát rõ ràng để rời khỏi trạng thái không mong muốn mà không cần quy trình phức tạp.
3.desc_en: Users often perform actions by mistake. They need a clearly marked 'emergency exit' to leave the unwanted action without having to go through an extended process.

sources.name: Nielsen Norman Group
sources.quote: Users need a clearly marked 'emergency exit' to leave the unwanted action.

4.name: Nielsen #4 — Consistency and Standards
4.desc_vi: Người dùng không nên phải thắc mắc liệu các từ, tình huống hoặc hành động khác nhau có cùng ý nghĩa hay không. Tuân theo các quy ước nền tảng.
4.desc_en: Users should not have to wonder whether different words, situations, or actions mean the same thing. Follow platform conventions.

sources.name: Nielsen Norman Group
sources.quote: Users should not have to wonder whether different words, situations, or actions mean the same thing.

sources.name: Laws of UX — Jakob's Law
sources.quote: Users spend most of their time on other sites. This means users prefer your site to work the same way as all the other sites they already know.

5.name: Nielsen #5 — Error Prevention
5.desc_vi: Thiết kế cẩn thận để ngăn ngừa lỗi xảy ra ngay từ đầu, tốt hơn cả việc hiển thị thông báo lỗi tốt. Với hành động nguy hiểm, hiện xác nhận trước khi thực hiện.
5.desc_en: Even better than good error messages is a careful design which prevents a problem from occurring in the first place.

sources.name: Nielsen Norman Group
sources.quote: A careful design which prevents a problem from occurring in the first place. Present users with a confirmation option before they commit to a destructive action.

sources.name: WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.4
sources.quote: For Web pages that cause legal commitments or financial transactions, submissions are reversible, checked, or confirmed.

6.name: Nielsen #6 — Recognition Rather Than Recall
6.desc_vi: Giảm thiểu tải nhớ của người dùng bằng cách làm cho đối tượng, hành động và tùy chọn có thể nhìn thấy được.
6.desc_en: Minimize the user's memory load by making objects, actions, and options visible.

sources.name: Nielsen Norman Group
sources.quote: Minimize the user's memory load by making elements, actions, and options visible.

sources.name: Laws of UX — Miller's Law
sources.quote: The average person can only keep 7 (plus or minus 2) items in their working memory.

7.name: Nielsen #7 — Flexibility and Efficiency of Use
7.desc_vi: Phím tắt — không hiển thị với người mới — có thể tăng tốc tương tác cho người dùng thành thạo, phục vụ cả 2 nhóm.
7.desc_en: Shortcuts — hidden from novice users — may speed up the interaction for the expert user.

sources.name: Nielsen Norman Group
sources.quote: Accelerators may speed up the interaction for expert users.

8.name: Nielsen #8 — Aesthetic and Minimalist Design
8.desc_vi: Giao diện không nên chứa thông tin không liên quan hoặc hiếm khi cần thiết. Mỗi đơn vị thông tin thừa cạnh tranh với thông tin quan trọng.
8.desc_en: Interfaces should not contain information which is irrelevant or rarely needed.

sources.name: Nielsen Norman Group
sources.quote: Every extra unit of information in an interface competes with the relevant units of information and diminishes their relative visibility.

9.name: Nielsen #9 — Help Users Recognize, Diagnose, and Recover from Errors
9.desc_vi: Thông báo lỗi phải được trình bày bằng ngôn ngữ đơn giản, chỉ rõ vấn đề và đề xuất giải pháp mang tính xây dựng.
9.desc_en: Error messages should be expressed in plain language, precisely indicate the problem, and constructively suggest a solution.

sources.name: Nielsen Norman Group
sources.quote: Error messages should be expressed in plain language (no codes), precisely indicate the problem, and constructively suggest a solution.

sources.name: WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.1
sources.quote: If an input error is automatically detected, the item that is in error is identified and the error is described to the user in text.

sources.name: WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.3
sources.quote: If an input error is automatically detected and suggestions for correction are known, then the suggestions are provided to the user.

10.name: Nielsen #10 — Help and Documentation
10.desc_vi: Mặc dù tốt nhất là hệ thống có thể sử dụng mà không cần tài liệu, nhưng có thể cần cung cấp trợ giúp và tài liệu.
10.desc_en: Even though it is better if the system can be used without documentation, it may be necessary to provide help and documentation.

sources.name: Nielsen Norman Group
sources.quote: Help and documentation should be easy to search, focused on the user's task, list concrete steps to be carried out.

3.3.1.name: WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.1 — Error Identification
3.3.1.quote: If an input error is automatically detected, the item that is in error is identified and the error is described to the user in text.

3.3.3.name: WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.3 — Error Suggestion
3.3.3.quote: If an input error is automatically detected and suggestions for correction are known, then the suggestions are provided to the user.

3.3.4.name: WCAG 2.2 SC 3.3.4 — Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
3.3.4.quote: For Web pages that cause legal commitments or financial transactions, submissions are reversible, checked, or confirmed.

2.5.8.name: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 — Target Size (Minimum)
2.5.8.quote: The size of the target for pointer inputs is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels.

fitts.name: Fitts's Law
fitts.desc: The time to acquire a target is a function of the distance to and size of the target.
fitts.quote: The time to acquire a target is a function of the distance to and size of the target.

hick.name: Hick's Law
hick.desc: The time it takes to make a decision increases with the number and complexity of choices.
hick.quote: The time it takes to make a decision increases with the number and complexity of choices.

peak_end.name: Peak-End Rule
peak_end.desc: People judge an experience largely based on how they felt at its most intense point and at its end.
peak_end.quote: People judge an experience largely based on how they felt at its most intense point and at its end.

millers.name: Miller's Law
millers.desc: The average person can only keep 7 (±2) items in their working memory.
millers.quote: The average person can only keep 7 (±2) items in their working memory.

jakobs.name: Jakob's Law
jakobs.desc: Users spend most of their time on other sites and prefer your site to work the same way.
jakobs.quote: Users spend most of their time on other sites. This means users prefer your site to work the same way.

trust.name: Banking Trust Principle
trust.desc: Trust is paramount in banking apps — every UI element must reinforce reliability and security.
